finalText: Migration finished. All 12 remaining files (`cohort.js`, `returnService.js`, `shipment.js`, `refund.js`, `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js`) now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the style of already-migrated files. The only remaining `db.query` call is in `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, which is a vendored third-party file explicitly marked "Do not edit — it is replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so I left it as-is.
